prior_importants.description: `listProcesses` finds `ps` on `PROBE_PATH`, which lists `/opt/homebrew/bin` and `/usr/local/bin` before `/usr/bin` and `/bin`, and the operator's uid can write both. The conductor can plant a `ps` there that prints nothing. `launchedAncestor()` then finds no ancestor, and `env -u PUP_CONDUCTOR pup plan edit … --rescope` from the conductor's own Bash succeeds and is recorded as the inferred operator, which is the very case ADR 0115 says is refused.

A rescope of a blocked session (or of an awaiting-review one the gate then parks) never reaches the worker's hooks. The only way to resume it, `pup unblock` then `pup kill --respawn`, relaunches from the launch-time compiled settings.json, scope-in.pat and context.md. Edits to the newly added globs stay BLOCKED even though the rescope reported success.

`listPanes` runs tmux with an environment holding only `PATH`, so tmux turns the tab separators in `PANE_FORMAT` into `_`; `listedPane` then never matches, and a rescope goes through while the session's window is open.

process_issues.description: Round 8 budget: spawned only correctness (2 instances, split core/CLI vs session-runtime probes), security (2 instances, split caller identity vs input handling) and guards. Conventions, docs, context, simplicity and maintainability were skipped under the round budget. Workflow-safety was skipped because the PR diff changes no `.github/workflows` file, and spec because no closing issue or spec source exists.
Not spawned: no reviewer returned a finding, so there was nothing to group.

Since the prior record (fa92d9b), the head (d3385a8) only merges main and touches none of the PR's files. All three prior importants are still in place at head: `listProcesses` and `listPanes` still run on `PROBE_PATH` with env `{ PATH: PROBE_PATH }` (session-runtime.service.ts:1117-1120, 1144-1147), and RESCOPABLE_STATES is still ['awaiting-review','merged'] (session.repository.ts:361).
